name: SearchAwesome Adware
desc: SearchAwesome adware intercepts encrypted web traffic to inject ads

acts.d: The user opens a disk image file which invisibly installs its components
Malware receives data from the C2 server
Malware inserts itself into a chain of custody, typically within network packets
The malware uses certificates to gain access to HTTPS traffic
Malware installs an open-source program called mitmproxy
Malware uses mitmproxy to intercept and modify web traffic
Malware intercepts encrypted web traffic to inject ads
Malware installs a script to inject a JavaScript script and modify web traffic
Malware can modify web traffic for the purpose of injecting Javascript
Malware will monitor if a specific file gets deleted and then will delete itself
